monster.label: Monster sheet (16x16, 4 directions x 4 walk frames)

hero.label: Fully animated character (32x32 frames, separate files per animation)

character.label: Simple character sheet (16x16, 4 directions; walk, swing, jump rows)

strip.label: One row of frames (boss idle strips); frame size set per role

icon.label: Item icon (one picture up to 16x16, centred in a 16x16 cell)

held.label: Held tool (one picture; the anchor is the grip)

prop.label: Scene prop (one picture, anchored at its bottom centre)

groups.label: Held tools (drawn in the player's hand)
